context.narrative_job: Support the spoken explanation with natural visible hand movement.
context.viewer_before: V4 provides accepted wide framing but hands mostly rest.
context.viewer_after: Distinct gestures accompany early, middle and late thoughts, separated by rests.

data.choice: Generate one 21-second full-wide take with more conversational gesture activity, then restore the original narration through the existing Fal connection.
data.reason: V4 explicitly constrained the hands to one gesture. Changing that instruction tests the owner request while preserving portrait, narration and reference roles.

alternatives.reason_not_selected: An editorial crop cannot create missing hand performance.
First test the minimal prompt correction; the current reference roles and framing are already accepted.

reuse.applies_when: This authorized EP007 opening gesture test.
reuse.avoid_when: Different spoken content or staging requires context-specific gesture review.

nuance.protected: Accepted V3 delivery recipe and V4 wide portrait; no canonical episode or publication changes.
nuance.performance: Several asymmetric gestures over whole thoughts with credible rests, not continuous waving or per-word beats.
nuance.uncertainty: Prompted hand movement is not a verified copy of the owner’s habitual gesturing; stochastic facial and anatomy drift remain review concerns.
nuance.review: Assess early, middle and question gesture activity, anatomy, body and face restraint, complete original audio and final settling.
